title: kdeconnect.mousepad.echo
description: This packet is an echo for a `kdeconnect.mousepad.request` packet.

key.description: A request to press-release a single readable character, which may be a unicode character and thus more than one byte.

specialKey.description:
A request to press-release a single non-printable character, usually a control character or func`tion key such as Backspace or F10. The mapping is as follows:

```
BackSpace // 1
Tab // 2
Linefeed // 3
Left // 4
Up // 5
Right // 6
Down // 7
Page_Up // 8
Page_Down // 9
Home // 10
End // 11
Return // 12
Delete // 13
Escape // 14
Sys_Req // 15
Scroll_Lock // 16
Control_L // 17
Alt_L // 18
Shift_L // 19
Super_L // 20
F1 // 21
F2 // 22
F3 // 23
F4 // 24
F5 // 25
F6 // 26
F7 // 27
F8 // 28
F9 // 29
F10 // 30
F11 // 31
F12 // 32
```

alt.description: Indicates whether the Alt modifier should be applied to the associated `key` or `specialKey`.

ctrl.description: Indicates whether the Control modifier should be applied to the associated `key` or `specialKey`.

shift.description: Indicates whether the Shift modifier should be applied to the associated `key` or `specialKey`.

super.description: Indicates whether the Super modifier should be applied to the associated `key` or `specialKey`.

singleclick.description: A single press-release of the primary pointer button.

doubleclick.description: A double press-release of the primary pointer button.

middleclick.description: A single press-release of the middle pointer button.

rightclick.description: A single press-release of the secondary pointer button.

singlehold.description: A single press of the primary pointer button.

singlerelease.description: A single release of the primary pointer button.

dx.description: A double precision integer indicating a relative position delta for the pointer on the X-axis.

dy.description: A double precision integer indicating a relative position delta for the pointer on the Y-axis.

scroll.description: Whether the associated `dx` or `dy` movement is a scroll event.

isAck.description: Indicates the packet is a confirmation of a request. Always `true` and always present.
